_comment: Tier-2 for dealii hyperelasticity#8. Unit block compressed 45% in five load steps, 4x4 Q1. The displacement reaches an infinity norm of 0.45 against a domain size of 1, so the deformation is comparable to the body itself. The probe then reads the geometry DataOut actually writes, straight out of DataOut::get_patches() rather than by parsing a file. Called as build_patches(1) the patch vertices span x in [0,1] and y in [0,1] -- exactly the undeformed triangulation, with the displacement present only as a data field. Called as build_patches(MappingQEulerian(1, dof, solution), 1) the same patches span x in [0,0.55] and y in [0,1.2499], which is the deformed body: the x extent matches 1 + (-0.45) to 1e-6. The claim is confirmed exactly as written. T2_MUTATE=1 supplies the Eulerian mapping. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against deal.II 9.8.0-pre (Release at ~/dealii/build); every expect_in_output string was copied from that run. No expectation depends on wall-clock time.
